about: Rules data for the plumbing fixtures' product records (bim.plumbing.products, Q6205): the kinds of plumbing product a schedule row, a submittal item or a Division 22 section names (first match wins, so a narrower word comes before a wider one), the words a submittal's product list and review letter are read by, and which fixtures take an electrical connection. Each list says where it comes from.
kinds_source: the usual names of plumbing products in fixture schedules and CSI Division 22 sections (MasterFormat 22 13 19, 22 11 19, 22 11 23, 22 14 29, 22 34 00, 22 42 00, 22 45 00, 22 47 00)
narrowing_why: a rough-in row for a narrower use (a commercial kitchen's sink) applies only when the schedule's fixture says so; the general row is the usual one (trade practice)

list_headers.source: a submittal package's table of contents and its item cover pages: the item tag, then each product's maker, description and the package page its cut sheet starts on

catalog_source: the labels a maker's cut sheet prints its catalog or model number under

review.source: the response codes of design-team submittal review stamps and letters (AIA G810-style actions): sent back first, not reviewed next, then approved, so NOT APPROVED and NOT REVIEWED aren't read as approved

submittal_name_why: files named for plumbing or Division 22 are read whole; others only when their first pages list the schedule's tags

powered.basis: trade practice: a pump's motor is wired by the electrical trade to a disconnecting means within sight of it (NEC 430.102)
its documents say it is powered (sensor, electronic or line-voltage operation): an equipment connection by the electrical trade (NEC 422)
its documents give it a power burner, blower, igniter or powered anodes: a 120 V equipment connection by the electrical trade (NEC 422.31)
a chilled drinking fountain or bottle filler has a compressor: a 120 V equipment connection by the electrical trade (NEC 422.52 GFCI where listed)

water_derived: its level's water lines are proposed (copied from a level whose layout matches, not drawn): its water connections are derived, not design-issued
